haikus.haiku:
Cream swirl in soft glaze
Pink dust sparkles, sweet breeze hums
Joy melts in each bite
Happy #NationalCreamFilledDonutDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Crayon rivers gleam
Paper waves swirl bright blue soft
Color dreams take flight
Happy #NationalColoringDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Morning mist kisses
Mountains hum with bright blue sky
Stars whisper soft light
#HappyBirthdayAlexandervonHumboldt from @ClamBakeSanta
